### Preparing for the Passover
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/preparing-passover
Passage: Matthew 26:17-19
Points:
- The disciples approached Jesus to ask where to make preparations for the required Passover feast.
- Jesus gave specific directions on finding the room, showing His foreknowledge and control.
- Preparing the traditional meal involved intricate details, including the lamb, herbs, and wine.
- Christ was not an accidental or helpless victim; He sovereignly orchestrated the events leading to the cross.

### Day 184: Luke 22:7–8
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-184-luke-22-78.html
Passage: Luke 22:7-8
Points:
- Jesus' selection of Peter and John to prepare the Passover meal was intentional rather than haphazard.
- The assignment of securing and preparing the lamb deeply shaped their later understanding of Jesus as the true Lamb.
- God uses daily assignments and practical tasks to instruct His servants and reveal spiritual truths.
- All former rituals and traditions find their ultimate meaning and fulfillment in Jesus Christ.
